text: dsh-wsl-github 是 DSH 的 GitHub 工具插件，注册配置提示和仓库状态查询两个工具。它可检查 GitHub App 配置，并查询当前仓库或指定仓库的开放 PR、最近一次 Actions 运行及其结果。认证支持 GitHub App 或 GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN。适合在 WSL 中查看代码评审和 CI 进度；使用前需准备 GitHub 凭据并安装 App。

dsh-wsl-github adds two GitHub tools to DSH: check App setup, or view a repository’s open pull requests and latest Actions run. It defaults to git origin and supports GitHub App or token authentication. Useful for WSL code review and CI checks; configure credentials and install the App.
想让 DSH 查看当前 GitHub 仓库有哪些尚未合并的 PR。
有没有办法在 DSH 里快速确认最近一次 GitHub Actions 是否通过？
让 agent 根据当前 git origin 查询仓库的 PR 和 CI 运行状态。
我想检查 GitHub App 是否配置好了，但不要把凭据显示出来。
How can I see a repository’s open pull requests and latest Actions run from DSH?
I need a DSH tool that reports GitHub App setup status without showing credentials.
dsh-wsl-github 的功能「配置提示」：检查 GitHub App 或 token fallback 是否已配置、环境文件是否存在，并返回设置建议；调用 github_app_hint，无需输入参数。
dsh-wsl-github 的功能「仓库 PR 与 Actions 状态」：查询指定仓库或默认 git origin 的开放 PR 及最近一次 Actions run，返回状态和网页链接。
dsh-wsl-github 的功能「GitHub App 注册」：运行 register-app 流程可在本机启动回调页面，完成 GitHub App 创建后将 App ID 和私钥路径写入 ~/.dsh。
能不能从 DSH 直接看某个 GitHub 项目的未关闭 PR？
我想知道仓库最新的自动化工作流运行结果。

dsh-wsl-github README · Why this plugin exists：WSL agents already have [`dsh-wsl-cred`](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-cred) (`cred_hint`) for **git push** credentials. They still need the **GitHub API** for “what PRs are open?” and “did CI pass?”—without dumping a PAT into chat.

dsh-wsl-github README · Why this plugin exists：This plugin mints a short-lived **GitHub App installation token** in memory. Tool output never includes the private key, JWT, or token. Pair with [`dsh-wsl-browser`](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-browser) (`win_open_url`) to open returned `html_url`s on Windows.

It is intentionally small. It is **not** a 40-tool GitHub connector.
dsh-wsl-github README · How it fits dsh-wsl-kit：DSH in **WSL** + Chat in a **Windows** browser is the kit’s home turf. GitHub work splits across plugins:

dsh-wsl-github README · How it fits dsh-wsl-kit：| Job | Plugin | Tool |
|-----|--------|------|
| Push / HTTPS credentials | [dsh-wsl-cred](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-cred) | `cred_hint` |
| API: open PRs + latest Actions | **this plugin** | `github_app_hint`, `github_repo_status` |
| Open PR / Actions in Windows | [dsh-wsl-browser](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-browser) | `win_open_url` |
| Proxy / Node 24 fetch issues | [dsh-wsl-net](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-net) | `net_doctor` |

dsh-wsl-github README · How it fits dsh-wsl-kit：**Why the kit path is convenient**

- One install pack (`dsh-wsl-kit` / `install.sh`) instead of ad-hoc PAT wiring.
- Secrets stay on disk under `~/.dsh/` and in process memory—not in Trajectory.
- Same mental model as the rest of the kit: small tools, clear OS boundary.
- Enough of a real GitHub App integration to join the [GitHub Developer Program](https://docs.github.com/en/integrations/concepts/github-developer-program).
dsh-wsl-github README · How it fits dsh-wsl-kit：Suite overview: [dsh-wsl-kit README](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#readme).

dsh-wsl-github README · Tools：| Tool | Role |
|------|------|
| `github_app_hint` | Whether App credentials / `~/.dsh/dsh-wsl-github.env` exist (existence only), setup + role split vs cred/ssh/`win_open_url` (no secrets) |
| `github_repo_status` | Open PRs (up to 5) + latest Actions run. `repo` optional; default is `git origin` |

After configuring the env file, self-check with `github_app_hint` (no live App e2e in CI — needs your PEM).

dsh-wsl-github README · End-to-end usage (WSL)：1. **Install the plugin** (with the kit or alone):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-github
```

2. **Register the GitHub App once** (permissions are pre-filled from [`github-app-manifest.json`](./github-app-manifest.json)):

```sh
npm run register-app
```

On GitHub: keep or rename the app → **Create GitHub App**. The script writes App ID + PEM to `~/.dsh/` and does **not** print secrets.

dsh-wsl-github README · End-to-end usage (WSL)：| Permission | Access | Why |
|------------|--------|-----|
| **Metadata** | Read | Repo name, default branch |
| **Pull requests** | Read | List open PRs |
| **Actions** | Read | Latest workflow run |
| Webhook | Off | This plugin polls the API; it does not receive events |
| Install scope | Private app (`public: false`) | Install on your account while developing |

dsh-wsl-github README · End-to-end usage (WSL)：3. **Install the App** on your GitHub account (link printed by the script, or [apps/dsh-wsl-github](https://github.com/apps/dsh-wsl-github)). Choose **All repositories** or only the repos you need.

4. **Load env before `dsh web`** (WSL / bash):

```sh
set -a
source "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-wsl-github.env"
set +a
dsh web

dsh-wsl-github README · End-to-end usage (WSL)：Manual App creation (no script): [Register a GitHub App](https://github.com/settings/apps/new), Homepage `https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit`, same permissions as the table, webhook off, then:

```sh
export GITHUB_APP_ID=123456
export GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH="$HOME/.dsh/dsh-wsl-github.pem"
```

`GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` is a last-resort smoke-test fallback, not the intended auth.

dsh-wsl-github README · End-to-end usage (WSL)：Optional: after the App can call the API, join the Developer Program at [github.com/developer/register](https://github.com/developer/register) (product website can be this kit or plugin repo URL).
